about: Oracle vectors for AW-2's writer: apply_run(state, runs, run) returns the new state.json and the lines to append to runs.jsonl (contract 5). Timelines replay bandit.py's scenarios through the v2 product: start from initial.state with an empty runs.jsonl, apply each step's run in order, append its lines, and compare the state after each step with history reduced to {length, newest}, and final.state in full. Cases give a state, the runs.jsonl lines that matter and one run, with optional bounds overrides. A timeline's rules name the v2 rules that make its decisions differ from bandit.py's; the decisions are the selector's, recorded in each run's receipt.

notes.before_reset: the run is numbered at or below reset_after_run
notes.older_definition: the run is of an older definition than the generation that started after it
notes.unsaved: a completed run whose agent ran but which wrote no line (written by a later save)
notes.no_agent: a run with no routing observation, because AWF did not route it or its agent made no request
notes.receipt_missing: a live run without a selection receipt
notes.receipt_mismatch: a live run whose receipt is not bound to it
notes.awaiting_success: a suspended pair failed before any model succeeded since its suspension: nothing counts

arithmetic: Compare numbers with a relative tolerance of 1e-9 (absolute 1e-12 near zero); compare everything else exactly.
memory(pair, now): the pair's history entries with now - time < 60 days, then the newest 50.
wins, losses: over memory, newest first, the k-th entry (k = 0 for the newest) weighs 0.98 ** k.
rate: a = wins + 4.5, b = losses + 0.5, p = a / (a + b); hopeful = min(0.999, p + sqrt(p (1 - p) / (a + b + 1))).

score(credits, p, P) = (credits + P (1 - p)) / p, with P = price[level]. A rival beats the incumbent when its score is strictly below the incumbent's hopeful score (equivalently, its rate strictly exceeds its need).

credits, model_credits, bills: over memory oldest first, the first entry with a cost sets the average and each later one makes it 0.9 x old + 0.1 x new; an entry with a cost but no model share counts all of it as the model's. tokens are averaged the same way over entries that have them, reasoning separately.
price(tariff, tokens) = input x in + cache_read x cr + cache_write x cw + output x out, where reasoning tokens are charged at the reasoning rate instead when both the tariff and the tokens have one.

estimate(X) = credits(inc) + model_credits(inc) x (price(X, tokens(inc)) / price(inc, tokens(inc)) - 1); with tokens but no measured incumbent cost, X costs price(X, tokens(inc)) and the incumbent its own price.

capacity: the largest n in 1..3 such that, after n - 1 assumed failures (each: wins x 0.98, losses x 0.98 + 1), the hopeful score still beats the incumbent's, streak + n - 1 stays below 3 (5 when runs + n - 1 > 20), and tests + n - 1 stays below 20.
Sizes for byte bounds are UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify output.

rules.share_follows_role: A test or probe needs the share: the scope's previous recorded live run was neither a test nor a probe. bandit.py gives tests every other trigger index instead.
rules.probe_follows_share: A due probe needs and uses up the share, like a test; bandit.py probes at once.
rules.probes_by_rank: Several due probes go in rank order; bandit.py takes them in the order it first saw the models.
rules.incumbent_from_evidence: Without a usable incumbent, the new one is the lowest expected score among pairs that have succeeded here and have a measured cost, else the highest-ranked pair that has succeeded here, else the first eligible pair. bandit.py takes the lowest expected score among every usable model, untried ones included.
rules.estimate_from_incumbent: A pair without a measured cost is priced from the incumbent's own tokens at the pair's tariff, and has no cost when the incumbent has no tokens; bandit.py starts untried models from the price table.
rules.full_rank: Incumbents, switches and probes must be in the router's full eligible rank, and the test shortlist is the first effort of up to three distinct base models after suspensions; bandit.py takes the router's top three, then drops suspended ones, and also uses any model with a record.
rules.all_suspended_choice: When every eligible base is suspended, serve the eligible pair with a record and the highest expected rate, ties by rank, else the ordinary pick; bandit.py takes the best of every suspended model, ties by first seen.
rules.credits_from_window: A pair's credits and bills come from the history entries in its 50-run, 60-day window, and the writer prunes older entries; bandit.py averages every cost a model ever had.
rules.test_spends_allowance: A dispatched test spends allowance even when its outcome does not count; bandit.py counts tests on outcomes.
rules.capacity: A test needs a turn and fewer earlier turn-holders in flight than the rival's capacity; a probe needs none in flight. bandit.py runs one trigger at a time.
rules.no_advisor: v2 has no advisor: attribution notes and candidate proposals are out of scope.

timelines.name: observe-release
timelines.title: Observe mode through the release in eco-live
timelines.note: observe mode has no bandit.py counterpart: the ordinary pick runs every time

cases.name: first-run
cases.about: The first run written starts the first generation and becomes the incumbent.

cases.name: duplicate-run
cases.about: A run already in runs.jsonl changes nothing.

cases.name: cost-without-model-share
cases.about: An entry with a cost but no model share counts all of it as the model's; no tokens leaves the average from the other entries.

cases.name: partial-bill-ignores-standalone-model-share
cases.about: A legacy entry with null total credits and non-null model_credits does not skew model_credits above credits.

cases.name: edit
cases.about: A run of a new definition starts a generation: failures, streaks, tests and suspensions go; successes stay; unexplained resets.

cases.name: older-definition
cases.about: A run of the older definition, numbered at or below the new generation's first run, is audit only.

cases.name: before-reset
cases.about: A run numbered at or below reset_after_run is audit only.

cases.name: after-reset
cases.about: The first run after a reset starts from empty scopes.

cases.name: probe-restores
cases.about: A suspended pair's success removes its pending failures and restores it.

cases.name: probe-confirms-break
cases.about: A failure after another model succeeded keeps only the pending failures and this one, and clears the suspension.

cases.name: late-test-result
cases.about: A test that was already running when its pair was suspended settles the suspension like a probe, and spends allowance.

cases.name: all-suspended-failure
cases.about: A run served while every pair is suspended, failing before any model has succeeded since, counts nothing.

cases.name: all-suspended-success
cases.about: The same run succeeding restores the pair.

cases.name: sibling-probe-restores
cases.about: When a suspended effort left the rank and a sibling effort probe succeeds, the base suspension clears and pending failures drop.

cases.name: sibling-probe-confirms-break
cases.about: When a sibling effort probe fails after another model succeeded, the base suspension clears with pending failures kept.

cases.name: sibling-probe-awaiting-success
cases.about: A sibling effort failing before any model succeeded since the base's suspension counts nothing.

cases.name: pending-aged-out
cases.about: A suspension whose oldest pending failure was pruned at an earlier write: the success removes what remains of them.

cases.name: stale-receipt
cases.about: A receipt decided on an older incumbent cannot switch, or undo a newer switch.

cases.name: switch
cases.about: A bound receipt whose before is the history's incumbent switches it and renews the new incumbent's allowance.

cases.name: receipt-missing
cases.about: A live run without a receipt counts nothing, counts as a test for the share, and is unexplained when exploration was allowed.

cases.name: receipt-missing-not-allowed
cases.about: Without a receipt but with exploration denied, the run is not unexplained.

cases.name: receipt-missing-no-outputs
cases.about: Without a receipt or the prepare step's outputs, the run is unexplained.

cases.name: receipt-mismatch
cases.about: A receipt that names another pair than AWF's selection record is not bound to the run.

cases.name: test-skipped
cases.about: A test that failed for infrastructure counts nothing but spends allowance.

cases.name: no-agent
cases.about: A run with no observation writes a no_agent line, changes no role and counts nothing.

cases.name: unsaved-runs
cases.about: Completed runs missing from runs.jsonl: failed with the agent run is unsaved and unexplained, without it no_agent; successful, skipped or already written runs are not charged.

cases.name: observe
cases.about: An observe run counts its outcome without a receipt, records the role observe and never changes the incumbent.

cases.name: history-bound
cases.about: Each pair keeps its newest 50 entries.

cases.name: costs-expire
cases.about: Entries older than 60 days are pruned, so their costs and tokens expire with them; a run without a known cost adds no bill.

cases.name: pair-bound
cases.about: Over the pair bound (4 here), the least recently seen pair that is neither the incumbent nor suspended is dropped.

cases.name: byte-bound
cases.about: Over the byte bound (1,709 bytes of JSON.stringify output here), the least recently seen pairs go first, before any count bound binds.

cases.name: scope-bound
cases.about: A fifth scope first drops the scope whose pairs were seen least recently.

cases.name: runs-bound
cases.about: runs.jsonl keeps its newest lines (5 here).

cases.name: reset
cases.about: gh aw routing reset fences off every run up to the latest one, empties the scopes and clears unexplained; runs.jsonl is kept.
